name: MoltNode by Chord
tagline: Hosted no-key MCP: read 31 blockchains over JSON-RPC, get DEX swap quotes and unsigned transactions via Chord.
description: A hosted MCP server over Streamable HTTP with no API key, no signup and no auth. `list_chains`, `rpc_call`, `get_block_number` and `get_balance` read 31 blockchains over JSON-RPC (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Solana, Monad, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Sui and more). `chord_find_token` and `chord_swap_quote` return a best-route DEX swap quote with the unsigned transaction, the approval and a simulation from the taker wallet, via Chord (getchord.xyz) on Base, Monad, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Robinhood Chain and Arc. `send_raw_transaction` broadcasts a transaction the agent signed. Non-custodial: the agent signs with its own key.
